## Changes

- Add `skill-length` for agent skill files in a `skills/` directory. Configure with `--max-kb` and `--max-ref-kb`.
  - `SKILL.md` over 8 KB (~2k tokens) fails, with advice to move detail into references.
  - Other Markdown there, such as references, over 12 KB (~3k tokens) fails, with advice to split it into one file per task.
